items.title: Bill Kirchner interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 4, 2021
items.q: I saw you perform at Joe Wilder’s memorial service. ... Oh yeah. 2014. With Bill Charlap.

ctx.x: staggered at how long the tracks were. And I’d like to think that they’re not boring or not going on past their bedtime. But they’re really extended and it’s just the two of us. So I mean you learn to pace yourself in a different way.
Thank you for that. We’ve been at this for over an hour so I have two more questions. I saw you perform at Joe Wilder’s memorial service.
